title: HtmlPreview
description: Previews untrusted HTML such as email templates in a fully sandboxed iframe. The markup is sanitized with DOMPurify (fail-closed) and rendered behind a Content-Security-Policy that blocks scripts and network access.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Inline styles and data: images are kept; scripts, forms, links and remote images are removed.

viewports.title: Viewports
viewports.description: viewport="mobile" renders a fixed-width preview (mobileWidth); desktop fills the container.

HtmlPreviewProps.html: Untrusted HTML to preview (sanitized in the browser)
HtmlPreviewProps.title: Accessible title of the iframe
HtmlPreviewProps.viewport: Full-width desktop preview or fixed-width mobile preview
HtmlPreviewProps.mobileWidth: Width of the mobile preview in pixels
HtmlPreviewProps.height: Height of the iframe in pixels
HtmlPreviewProps.className: Additional class name of the root element
HtmlPreviewProps.style: Inline styles of the root element
